# CNC Display — Kongto Technology

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2013 | Location: Shenzhen, China
- Products: CRT to LCD retrofit modules, industrial video signal converters, custom industrial displays
- Brands covered: FANUC, Mitsubishi, Siemens, Mazak, Okuma, Haas, Heidenhain, Toshiba
- Top models: FANUC A61L-0001-0093, Mitsubishi MDT962B, Mazak CD1472-D1M, Siemens 6FC3988-7FA20, Okuma OSP5000
- Certifications: CE, RoHS, FCC, ISO9001:2015
- Warranty: 2 years | Ships globally via DHL/FedEx
- Key advantage: Plug-and-play, 30-min install, no CNC parameter modification needed
